name.zh: L 撑到 V 撑画圈

purpose.zh: 在支撑中练双腿画圈和抬高控制
purpose.en: Train leg circles and lift control in support.

text.zh: 撑起身体，双腿从L撑画圈抬到V撑
text.en: Press up and circle your legs from the L-sit up toward a V-sit
Press your shoulders down and lock your arms.

text.zh: 两个方向各画一圈，动作慢而稳
text.en: Circle once in each direction, slowly and steadily.

commonErrors.en: Circling too fast and losing control.

cautions.zh: 手腕热身后再做；腕部或肩部疼痛时缩短时间或改简单版本
cautions.en: Warm up your wrists first; if your wrists or shoulders hurt, shorten the hold or use an easier version.
